meta.name: Love & Hip Hop
meta.description:
From the Big Apple to The A – classic episodes of VH1’s Love & Hip Hop, Love & Hip Hop New York and Love & Hip Hop Atlanta come together on Pluto TV. Watch hip hop artists live, learn, and love as they navigate the music industry.

Shows: Love & Hip Hop Hollywood Series, You Trippin', Black Diamond, The Kids Are Alright, Shut It Down
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus
